Try a one-line ending tonight: “The next small step I want to try is…” Keep the answer for yourself. #manifestation #affirmations #journaling #intentions #selfcare #morningroutine

A review is a place for observations, not a score for your worth. Try these three questions in your journal. #manifestation #affirmations #journaling #intentions #selfcare #morningroutine
No perfect opening line needed. “Today, I’m here” is a journal prompt you can borrow. #manifestation #affirmations #journaling #intentions #selfcare #morningroutine
Tonight’s prompt: What small moment would I like to keep? You do not have to turn it into a lesson. #manifestation #affirmations #journaling #intentions #selfcare #morningroutine

A small visual cue, chosen by you. Poleris wallpapers are saved first; you choose when to apply one in your phone settings. #manifestation #affirmations #journaling #intentions #selfcare #morningroutine
Your affirmation does not need to predict the future. Try language you feel comfortable returning to. #manifestation #affirmations #journaling #intentions #selfcare #morningroutine
Intention → action. Try this pair in your journal, then make it your own. Keep names and messages private. #manifestation #affirmations #journaling #intentions #selfcare #morningroutine

Gratitude does not have to erase a difficult day. You can write one appreciated detail and still leave room for everything else. #manifestation #affirmations #journaling #intentions #selfcare #morningroutine
Try a sound as part of your evening ritual. This demo keeps the app open; it makes no promise about sleep outcomes. #manifestation #affirmations #journaling #intentions #selfcare #morningroutine

Save the prompt if it is useful. You do not need to post your intention or send it to anyone to use Poleris. #manifestation #affirmations #journaling #intentions #selfcare #morningroutine
A share card can keep a simple prompt in view. Preview it first, and use a sample intention for public demos. #manifestation #affirmations #journaling #intentions #selfcare #morningroutine
Explore a 21-day journey in Poleris. The number describes the format, not a deadline for changing yourself. #manifestation #affirmations #journaling #intentions #selfcare #morningroutine
